### {{VERSION}} — bug fix

**Collapsed chest sections are now remembered per raid.** They were stored as one list shared by every raid: collapsing the chests of one raid collapsed them for all the others as soon as the page was reloaded. Most visible in the **Favorites** tab, where several raids are on screen at once.

One-time side effect of the fix: sections collapsed before this update are forgotten, so everything starts expanded once.

Nothing else changed — loot history, pins and all other data carry over from 1.3.1 untouched.
